name: image
description: A picture, sized to its column, with the words that stand in for it and an optional caption.

use.when: a photo, a scan or a drawing is part of what the page says: a file's own page, a note's picture.
use.not: an icon, which comes from the component that owns it; or a chart, which is a chart.
use.with: alt text that says what it shows that matters here.

alt.description: What the picture shows that matters here, for someone who cannot see it. Empty only when it is decoration and the words around it say everything.

caption.description: Seen by everyone, under the picture.

width.description: Its width in pixels, when known, so the page does not jump as it loads.

loading.description: eager for a picture seen as the page opens, such as the first thing on it; lazy waits until it is scrolled near.

still.description: A still picture of one that moves, shown first; with scripts a Play button shows it moving and Stop stills it.

a11y.role: img, named by its alt text; figure with its caption when it has one

wcag.notes: Alt text is required, so a picture is never left for a screen reader to read out its file name (1.1.1). Empty alt is a decision that it is decoration. A caption is a figcaption, tied to the picture. It never grows past its column (1.4.10).

machine.identify: The img's alt says what it shows; figcaption, when present, is its caption.
machine.operate: Nothing to operate; it only shows.
